question: After provisioning an IdentityService pod, how do I start BuildAcceptanceTests and track them, and should I expect my manually enabled MFA setting to remain enabled during that run?

result.question: After provisioning an IdentityService pod, how do I start BuildAcceptanceTests and track them, and should I expect my manually enabled MFA setting to remain enabled during that run?
result.answer:
Before you start, note these restrictions from the cited documentation:
> 1. PipelineHub will have a post pod action Enable/Disable MFA and based on the user choice the post pod action will call the corresponding JC's on the IdentityService or IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods only , this feature is not available for IDM and the UI should not show this feature for IDM PODs. [doc-0098]

> * To enable BATSnapper, the user must include `ENABLE_BATSNAPPER=true` in the `Additional Params` when submitting BuildAcceptanceTests. [doc-0060]

> * Previously, BATSnapper’s pre-buildacceptancetests and post-buildacceptancetests hooks were called only once. With this update, these hooks will be called every time the user re-runs the tests. [doc-0060]

> * This feature is available only when BATSnapper is enabled. [doc-0060]

> * ### I have merged an WorkspaceCLI transaction and I do not see it is built yet, where do I check in PipelineHub what is happening with it? [doc-0001]

Documented guidance:
- BuildAcceptanceTests will automatically disable MFA on the POD as they cannot run with MFA enabled, irrespective of any manual MFA settings configured during provisioning or post-provisioning actions. [doc-0098]
- To start BuildAcceptanceTests, include the parameter ENABLE_BATSNAPPER=true in the Additional Params when submitting the test job if BATSnapper integration is required. [doc-0060]
- Users can track the status of their project by navigating to the Project Pipeline and filtering for the specific project name. [doc-0001]
- The status of a transaction, including whether it is built or not, can be viewed by selecting the Build/Pipeline Run which lists all transactions. [doc-0001]

Sources:
- [doc-0098] PipelineHub Preflight - Post Pod Actions - Toggle MFA
- [doc-0060] PipelineHub Preflight - Provisioning
- [doc-0001] PipelineHub User Guide

Links, commands, and configurations in this adapted documentation are illustrative.

retrieved_sources.title: PipelineHub Preflight - Post Pod Actions - Toggle MFA
retrieved_sources.text:
Toggle MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) 

1. PipelineHub will have a post pod action Enable/Disable MFA and based on the user choice the post pod action will call the corresponding JC's on the IdentityService or IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods only , this feature is not available for IDM and the UI should not show this feature for IDM PODs.
2. if MFA is disabled then the users will be able to login with user name and password on the IdentityService and IdentityService/ManagedDatabase pods
3. if the MFA is enabled user will be prompted for extra authentication to be able to login to the PODs
4. if BuildAcceptanceTests are triggered, BuildAcceptanceTests will automatically disable the MFA on the POD as BuildAcceptanceTests cannot run with MFA on, so when BuildAcceptanceTests are triggered the assumption is that MFA will be disabled (this will be done during the BuildAcceptanceTests run) , irrespective of what the user has done during prov or post prov action.

Eligible PODS (IdentityService) will have the option in the post pod actions - TOGGLE MFA

The user will be able to ENABLE MFA or DISABLE MFA based on the option selected (true or false)

retrieved_sources.text:
Filter tag All is now defaulted for all DeploymentTemplate Run Tests submissions. This will be empty for STARTER jobs.   

Reference - <https://issues.example.com/reference/resource-416>

Reach out to BusinessApp QA to get details about values that can be used for these parameters. 

Testing Parameters: 

* `AcceptanceTests Label`
* `Order prop`
* `Filter tags`
* `BuildAcceptanceTests Config`
* Git Branch
* `Additional Params`

#### BATSnapper Integration to BuildAcceptanceTests for PSR

* To enable BATSnapper, the user must include `ENABLE_BATSNAPPER=true` in the `Additional Params` when submitting BuildAcceptanceTests.
* Previously, BATSnapper’s pre-buildacceptancetests and post-buildacceptancetests hooks were called only once. With this update, these hooks will be called every time the user re-runs the tests.
* This feature is available only when BATSnapper is enabled.

### ManagedDatabase Enabled Flag

EnvironmentService-Uptake ManagedDatabase Flag in provisioning submissions. If the template is ManagedDatabase enabled. This is for the users who wants to use PipelineHub for ADBS provisioning jobs. 

this is a requirement for LifecycleManager to be able to use PipelineHub for ADBS prov

Support Enabled DB info check box for EnvironmentService provisioning

PipelineHub now support with "Enabled DB info" check box feature for EnvironmentService provisioning which works exactly like GEN1.

 

X86 is defaulted for provisioning, ARM Pods are based on user selection 

X86 is now the default for POD provisioning. User should click "***Provision an ARM64 pod***" if they want an ARM pod.

* ### My integrator advised me to look at the Build Status via PipelineHub - how do I start that?

	+ Navigate to the default home page and search Or pick from the recently searched project.

* + Search for your series or project name (you can just type in part of the name) and select the appropriate one.

* + Navigate to the Project Pipeline and filter to the project you are looking for
* My manager/integrator advised me to check the status of my WorkspaceCLI transaction via PipelineHub - how do I do that?
	+ Search for your series or project name (you can just type in part of the name) and select the appropriate one to navigate to Project Details page.
	+ Look for the section below Merge Requests that lists all the transactions in the recent past::
